title: From Defender to Devil? Unintended Risk Interactions Induced by LLM Defenses
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not measure anything specific to faith or religion. It evaluates general risks in LLMs across three categories: safety (toxicity, misuse, exaggerated safety), fairness (bias recognition, bias agreement, bias query), and privacy (privacy agreement, privacy query, privacy leakage). The fairness metrics assess general social biases and stereotypes without focusing on religious ones.
findings: This paper does not contain any findings related to religion or faith, as it was not a focus of the research.
